prompt.subtitle: Image / video prompt library with one-click generation
prompt.desktopOnly: The prompt tool is desktop-only: generation needs a local ComfyUI and native media capabilities.
prompt.libEmptyHint: Create one, or add a few from the samples below
prompt.copyFailed: Copy failed — select and copy manually
prompt.editorPositivePh: Describe the image; supports {'{{variable}}'} placeholders filled when generating or copying
prompt.updatedExternally: The prompt library was updated outside this tool
prompt.deleteConfirmMsg: Delete “{title}”? The deletion syncs to your other devices.
prompt.impPh: Paste exported content, or choose a file
prompt.impErrBadFormat: This file was not exported by this tool
prompt.impErrBadShape: Unrecognized structure — use this tool's export format
prompt.backendBuiltinHint: Generate with a local ComfyUI using the standard txt2img graph
prompt.backendWorkflowHint: Import a ComfyUI “API format” workflow — runs video and any other pipeline
prompt.cloudNotReady: Cloud image generation is not configured yet
prompt.comfyFailHint: Make sure ComfyUI is running at the right address (default http://127.0.0.1:8188). Actual error:
prompt.noCheckpointHint: No checkpoint available: put model files (.safetensors) in ComfyUI's models/checkpoints folder, then click "Check connection"
prompt.modelsFound: Models detected in your local ComfyUI:
prompt.modelsNoCheckpoint: No all-in-one checkpoint found (the built-in text-to-image needs one). Use “Custom workflow” to import a workflow saved in your local ComfyUI to generate images or videos.
prompt.splitHint: No all-in-one checkpoint found — using a split UNET + CLIP + VAE combo (equivalent to running it directly in ComfyUI):
prompt.varsHint: Filled values replace {'{{variable}}'} when generating or copying
prompt.cancelInterruptMsg: This task is still running. Canceling interrupts whatever ComfyUI is executing right now (including your other jobs, if any). Continue?
prompt.wsLost: Progress connection lost — switched to polling (the task keeps running)
prompt.errConfig: Generation service is not fully configured (URL / key / model)
prompt.errAuth: Auth failed — check the API key
prompt.errNetwork: Network unreachable — check the service address and network
prompt.errNoOutputs: Finished with no output files (does the workflow have a SaveImage / SaveVideo style node?)
prompt.errJobTimeout: Timed out after 30 minutes — stopped waiting
prompt.videoHint: If inline playback fails, use “Open” to play with the system player
prompt.histRerunNoSource: The original prompt was deleted — cannot rerun
prompt.histRerunNoWorkflow: The original workflow was deleted — cannot rerun
prompt.histDeleteConfirmMsg: Delete this record and its local files?
prompt.histMediaMissing: Media file missing (cleaned up, or from an old backup)
prompt.setInherited: Filled from the current AI settings
prompt.setSendNegativeTip: Some services reject negative prompts; turn this off if you get errors
prompt.setBackupNote: Generated files are stored in the local media folder and are not part of data backups; use “Save as” to keep a copy.
prompt.setInvalidUrl: The address must start with http:// or https://
prompt.wfImportPh: Paste the content exported by ComfyUI “Save (API format)”, or choose a file
prompt.wfErrUiFormat: This is a UI-format workflow and could not be converted automatically: enable dev mode in ComfyUI settings and export with “Save (API format)”
prompt.wfLocalHint: Pick a workflow saved in your local ComfyUI (UI format is converted automatically)
prompt.wfLocalEmpty: No saved workflows found in your local ComfyUI
prompt.wfOverrideTip: By default only the prompt and a random seed are injected; the workflow keeps its own parameters
prompt.wfStale: Mapping is stale: the selected node no longer exists — edit the mapping again
prompt.wfTooLarge: The workflow exceeds the 2MB size limit
prompt.wfCap: Up to {n} workflows — delete one first
